findings.note: Game 2 of the ALCS is at Tropicana Field, Parker Messick (5.40 ERA, 1.80 WHIP, 6 walks in 6.2 postseason innings) against Freddy Peralta (1.93 ERA). ESPN's listed total is 7, so the 6.5 line on this bet is half a run lower than that market.

Cleveland beat Tampa Bay 7-3 in Game 1, a 10-run game. Starter Foster Griffin lasted only four innings and was followed by five relievers going one inning each, so Cleveland's bullpen could be tired for Game 2.
Says the Rays staff allowed only 5 runs in 27 innings against the Yankees before giving up 7 runs in four innings in Game 1. It also says Cleveland wore out its pitching staff in a five-game ALDS.
